Menu

🍽️ **Coastal View Multi-Cuisine Dining & Restaurant:**

We serve fresh Bay of Bengal catch, authentic Bengali seafood delicacies, comforting vegetarian thalis, and coastal delights:

• **Signature Seafood:** Fresh Hilsa (Ilish Bhapa / Shorshe Ilish), Jumbo Prawns Malai Curry, Fresh Sea Crabs
• **Traditional Thalis:** Pure Vegetarian Thali, Fish Thalis, Chicken & Mutton Kasha
• **Snacks & Starters:** Crispy Pomfret Fry, Prawn Butter Garlic, Chicken Pakora
